tools.name: inspect_payment
tools.description: FREE. Pure deterministic inspection of a proposed payment against structured policy (amount/network/asset/recipient/resource) — no external evidence, no sanctions screening, no cryptographic signing, no receipt. Returns the same ALLOW / REQUIRE_APPROVAL / BLOCK decision semantics as POST /x402/prefl

tools.name: inspect_allowance
tools.description: FREE. Deterministically inspect an ERC-20 allowance/revocation request against explicit network/token/spender/value policy. No wallet action, no signing, no chain read unless a separately requested preflight asks for it.

tools.name: preflight_allowance
tools.description: Call BEFORE an agent asks its wallet to approve or revoke a Base USDC ERC-20 allowance. OCD evaluates strict policy and returns a signed portable allowance artifact. ALLOW is policy only, never wallet authority.

tools.name: observe_allowance
tools.description: Given a signed OCD allowance preflight artifact and submitted Base transaction hash, independently inspect its canonical-USDC Approval event, Base safe-head finality, and historical allowance state. OCD never executes the transaction.

tools.name: inspect_swap
tools.description: FREE. Deterministically inspect a narrow Base USDC-to-WETH direct Uniswap V3 swap against explicit policy. No wallet action or signing.

tools.name: preflight_swap
tools.description: Call BEFORE an agent asks its wallet to execute a narrow Base USDC-to-WETH direct Uniswap V3 swap. OCD returns a signed portable policy artifact. ALLOW is policy only, never wallet authority.

tools.name: observe_swap
tools.description: Given a signed OCD swap preflight artifact and Base transaction hash, independently inspect direct Uniswap V3 exactInputSingle calldata, ERC-20 transfers, and Base safe-head finality. OCD never executes the swap.

tools.name: inspect_bridge
tools.description: FREE. Deterministically inspect a narrow Circle CCTP V2 Base-to-Ethereum native-USDC bridge request against explicit policy. No wallet action, no signing, no chain read.

tools.name: preflight_bridge
tools.description: Call BEFORE an agent asks its wallet to bridge Base USDC to Ethereum via Circle CCTP V2 (depositForBurn). OCD evaluates strict policy and returns a signed portable bridge artifact. ALLOW is policy only, never wallet authority.

tools.name: observe_bridge
tools.description: Given a signed OCD bridge preflight artifact, the Base depositForBurn transaction hash, and (once available) the Ethereum receiveMessage transaction hash, independently observe both chains, verify the CCTP message identity matches, and reconcile against the authorized action. Source-only observation

tools.name: inspect_staking
tools.description: FREE. Deterministically inspect a narrow Ethereum Lido stETH submit request against explicit policy. No wallet action, signing, or chain read.

tools.name: preflight_staking
tools.description: Call BEFORE an agent asks its wallet to submit ETH to Lido stETH. OCD evaluates strict policy and returns a signed portable staking artifact. ALLOW is policy only, never wallet authority.

tools.name: observe_staking
tools.description: Given a signed OCD staking preflight artifact and Ethereum transaction hash, independently inspect the canonical Lido Submitted event, transaction sender/value, optional minted shares, and Ethereum finalized-head finality. OCD never stakes ETH.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: inspect_payment · Private data: screen_wallet, verify_us_company, diligence, preflight_payment, inspect_allowance, preflight_allowance, inspect_swap, preflight_swap, inspect_bridge, preflight_bridge, inspect_staking, preflight_staking, get_receipt · Public sink: inspect_payment, inspect_staking, preflight_staking · Destructive: preflight_swap, get_receipt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: inspect_payment · Private data: screen_wallet, verify_us_company, diligence, preflight_payment, inspect_allowance, preflight_allowance, inspect_swap, preflight_swap, inspect_bridge, preflight_bridge, inspect_staking, preflight_staking, get_receipt · Public sink: inspect_payment, inspect_staking, preflight_staking · Destructive: preflight_swap, get_receipt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
